items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: He called me a pretty full time, told me when his job was going to start, when he was going to make records and everything

ctx.x: Well that's the thing most that killed me up. Well now, who did you work with in New York?

What did he work with? His name's Stone. The last name is Stone. I can't think of his first name. What did he work with? I was to make piano, I was to make records with him, and the same show, see how I got to New York, when the carnival closed, Charlie Taylor was the man who had the brown mannequin. He said, Puncher, never lived in New York, no time, why don't you come on and go up there with me and stay with me, just you know, just winter, until I get ready for my show to go out and then we'd all come out…
I can't think of who that would be. His name's Stone, anybody tell you.
